dataset: all500 LongMemEval-S frozen20261018; development-set evaluation, NOT held-out

inference.actual_weight_revision: unknown; response alias and usage recorded
inference.note: Local self-hosted route selected; monetary provider receipt and immutable runtime weight revision unavailable. Do not fabricate either.

execution.variant_order: counterbalanced deterministically by sorted query index; same retrieval for both
execution.checkpoint: per call, durable pending before dispatch, completed before next call; unknown pending blocks auto replay
execution.failures: retain and stop; no inferred verdicts, blind retries or silent model fallback

calibration.source: public2026-07-24 recorded reader answers and Sonnet4.5 verdicts; comparator labels, NOT human truth
calibration.nonpreference_sample: 12 per each of five categories, SHA256(seed227|query_id) order; 6correct/6incorrect where available, fill remaining by hash
calibration.preference_sample: all30, reported separately; never gate against ambiguous historic labels
calibration.blind_duplicates: first10 selected nonpreference cases by SHA256 order; no original judgment or variant labels shown
calibration.gate: at least90% agreement with60 recorded nonpreference verdicts; at least90% duplicate consistency; all6controls; no malformed/truncated/incomplete calls. Failure means no trustworthy headline answer-quality claim and keep candidate experimental.

analysis.primary: paired judged-correct count across all500, gained/lost IDs, category results and abstention
analysis.preferences: 30case primary outcome plus separately frozen preference-aware rubric sensitivity on same saved answers, original rubric remains unchanged
analysis.evidence_regressions: explicitly analyze six#390 losses and prior29cohort, without algorithm retuning
promotion_gate: paired accuracy improvement>=5percentagepoints with95%CI lower bound>0
no category with at least30cases loses more than5percentagepoints
independent held-out or representative real-agent evidence available
analysis.decision: Any unmet promotion gate retains experimental status; measured benefit on this development set cannot imply generalization. No holdout is presently available. A documented no-go is an accepted sprint endpoint.

completion: Report paired answer quality and limits; retain experimental status if any adoption gate is unfulfilled.
